warnings.heading: THIRD CATEGORY WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS
warnings.text: SECTION A: FOR MALAYSIAN WATERS [WITHIN 24 NAUTICAL MILES] 1) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Penang • Perak • Selangor • East Johor • Pahang • Terengganu • Kelantan • Sarawak • Eastern Sabah until 10:00 AM; Monday, 23 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats. SECTION B: FOR SHIPPING 1) WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS (THIRD CATEGORY) Strong northeasterly winds over 60 kmph with waves exceeding 4.5 metres are expected over the water of Northeastern Condore until Tuesday, 24 November 2026. This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous to all coastal and shipping activities including workers on oil platforms. 2) WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS (SECOND CATEGORY) Strong northeasterly winds of 50 - 60 kmph with wave height up to 4.5 metres are expected over the waters of Northwestern Condore • Northwestern Reef North until Tuesday, 24 November 2026. This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous to all shipping and coastal activities including fishing and ferry services. 3) WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS (FIRST CATEGORY) Strong northeasterly winds of 40 - 50 kmph with wave height up to 3.5 metres are expected over the waters of Southeastern Samui • Northern Tioman • Southern part of Condore • Southwestern and Northeastern parts of Reef North until Tuesday, 24 November 2026. This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous to small crafts, recreational sea activities and water sports. 4) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Condore • Southeastern and Northwestern parts of Bunguran • Sulu • Tioman • Palawan • Reef South • Northwestern Reef North • Straits Of Melaka • Western part of Phuket until 10:00 AM; Monday, 23 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats.
